Shitet apartament 1+1 ne Don Bosko Rruga Egnatia.
Organizohet nga 1 ambient gatimi dhe ndenje bashke,1 dhome gjumi,1 tualet.
Apartamenti eshte i shtruar me parket dhe ndodhet ne katin 8 te nje pallati me ashensor dhe te mireadministruar.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje nga zonat me te cilat jane te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshem si shkolla, kopeshte etj.
Per me shume informacione na kontaktoni.
description_en: 1+1 apartment for sale in Don Bosko Egnatia Street. It is organized by 1 common kitchen and living room, 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom. The apartment is laid with parquet and is located on the 8th floor of a well-managed building with an elevator. The apartment is located in one of the areas with all the necessary facilities such as schools, kindergartens, etc. For more information, contact us.
